blur_detection.description: The receipt exhibits clear text with well-defined edges and excellent focus throughout the document.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed; current image quality is sufficient for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt displays excellent contrast between the black text and light background, creating highly legible content.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No improvement needed for contrast; maintain similar lighting conditions for future captures.

glare_identification.description: No visible glare or reflections are present that would obscure text or important information.
glare_identification.recommendation: Continue using diffused lighting when capturing receipt images to avoid glare.

water_stains.description: No water damage, discoloration, or staining is visible on the receipt.
water_stains.recommendation: Continue to protect receipts from liquid exposure before scanning.

tears_or_folds.description: The receipt shows minor creasing but no significant folds that impact text readability.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: Consider using a document flattener or placing under a heavy book briefly before scanning.

cut_off_detection.description: The receipt is fully captured within the frame with no cut-off edges or missing content.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: Maintain current framing technique to ensure complete document capture.

missing_sections.description: All standard receipt sections are present including header, line items, total, and footer information.
missing_sections.recommendation: Continue to verify all receipt sections are visible before finalizing image capture.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows, or objects obstruct any portion of the receipt content.
obstructions.recommendation: Maintain current capture technique that keeps the document free from obstructions.
